note: Names, descriptions and grades are as PlayStation publishes them, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles and carried in the make.fun starter kit. Hidden flags (28 hidden) are cross-checked against Insider Gaming's hidden / non-hidden split and howtovideogame's hidden breakdown, which agree. Every guide below is written in our own words for this entry and names its sources; no guide text is copied from a source.

trophies.guide: The platinum pops by itself once the other 54 trophies are earned, so there is nothing to do for it directly. Work through the roadmap in this guide — story first, then strangers and meditation spots, then activities, crime and collectibles, and finally the 100% checklist — and this trophy is the last one to land. Source: the official description itself, as listed by Insider Gaming and PushSquare.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, which is the first story mission of the game. It unlocks automatically when the mission ends, so just play through the opening as directed. Source: the official description, as listed by Insider Gaming (hidden list) and PushSquare.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Play through every story mission of Chapter 1 until the chapter closes. Chapter trophies cannot be missed: keep following the story markers and this pops at the chapter's end. Source: the official description, as listed by Insider Gaming (hidden list) and PushSquare.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Play through every story mission of Chapter 2 until the chapter closes. Like the other chapter trophies it is automatic and unmissable — finish the chapter and it pops. Source: the official description, as listed by Insider Gaming (hidden list) and PushSquare.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Play through every story mission of Chapter 3 until the chapter closes. It is a story trophy, so it unlocks automatically when the chapter ends and cannot be missed. Source: the official description, as listed by Insider Gaming (hidden list) and PushSquare.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Play through every story mission of Chapter 4 until the chapter closes. It is the last chapter trophy before the finale, unlocked automatically at the end of the chapter. Source: the official description, as listed by Insider Gaming (hidden list) and PushSquare.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission. Some guides word this trophy as completing Chapter 5, which is the same event described another way — the final mission is the end of the story. It unlocks automatically and cannot be missed; after it, free roam continues, so cleanup can follow. Sources: the official description as listed by Insider Gaming (hidden list) and PushSquare; the Chapter 5 wording is reported by Beebom and CULTR via EGamers.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run when it appears in the story flow. Mission trophies unlock automatically on completion and cannot be missed — play the mission through to its end. Source: the official description, as listed by Insider Gaming (hidden list) and PushSquare.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist when it appears in the story flow. It is a mission trophy, so it pops automatically when the mission ends and cannot be missed. Source: the official description, as listed by Insider Gaming (hidden list) and PushSquare.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play when it appears in the story flow. Mission trophies unlock automatically on completion and cannot be missed. Source: the official description, as listed by Insider Gaming (hidden list) and PushSquare.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners when it appears in the story flow. It pops automatically when the mission ends and cannot be missed. Source: the official description, as listed by Insider Gaming (hidden list) and PushSquare.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown when it appears in the story flow. It pops automatically when the mission ends and cannot be missed. Source: the official description, as listed by Insider Gaming (hidden list) and PushSquare.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory when it appears in the story flow. It pops automatically when the mission ends and cannot be missed. Source: the official description, as listed by Insider Gaming (hidden list) and PushSquare.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion using the game's own in-game checklist. This is the hardest trophy on the list and the last one most players earn: it asks for the story, the stranger strands, the collectibles and the activities together. PushSquare estimates the platinum hunt at up to 300 hours or more, and PowerPyx (via EGamers) notes the 100% checklist is roughly 60% of true completion, so treat this as the final cleanup stage after the story, not a first goal. Do it last, after every other trophy. Sources: the official description as listed by Insider Gaming and PushSquare; difficulty and checklist notes from EGamers and PushSquare.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts across Leonida — jumps, near misses, long air time and similar driving feats, counted as you go. This is a slow grind best done naturally while driving between missions and cleanup, rather than farmed in one sitting. The count is tracked by the game, so check your progress in the stats as you play. Sources: the official description as listed by Insider Gaming and PushSquare; the 250-stunt count is the description itself.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types at least once — one taste of every side activity the game offers, from sports and games to races and challenges. Open the activities list in game and work down it: one attempt at each type is enough, you do not need to win or master any of them. The 9-type count is reported by KeenGamer. Sources: the official description as listed by Insider Gaming and PushSquare; the count of 9 activity types from KeenGamer.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every one of the 42 Shooting Range challenges. Visit the shooting ranges around Leonida, learn each challenge's target pattern, and replay any challenge until it clears gold — every challenge must be gold, not just passed. Together with A Long Road this is rated one of the hardest trophies on the list. Sources: the official description as listed by Insider Gaming and PushSquare; the 42-challenge count from KeenGamer and GamesFuze; difficulty ranking from EGamers.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Find each Top Fun race spot, learn its course, and win at least once per location — a win at every spot is required, not 14 wins at one spot. The 14-location count is reported by KeenGamer. Sources: the official description as listed by Insider Gaming and PushSquare; the location count from KeenGamer.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — 20 distinct race events, not the same race 20 times. Work through the race types across Leonida (street, off-road and the other race series) and tick off a new event each time you win one. Sources: the official description as listed by Insider Gaming and PushSquare.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Challenge Cal to a fishing challenge and beat him. Fishing is one of the side activities: find Cal at a fishing spot, accept his challenge, and out-fish him by landing the better catch within the challenge's rules. Sources: the official description as listed by Insider Gaming and PushSquare.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Find an arcade machine in Leonida and play one arcade game through to its end. Any arcade game counts — pick the shortest one you enjoy and finish a full run of it. Sources: the official description as listed by Insider Gaming and PushSquare.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Follow Andy's stranger mission strand to its end and complete his final mission. Stranger strands unlock as the story progresses, so meet Andy when his strand appears and keep returning for his missions. TechWiser (via EGamers) reports that stranger strands have windows tied to story progress, so do not leave Andy's strand until after the story — finish it while the story is still running. Source: the official description, as listed by Insider Gaming (hidden list); the story-window warning from EGamers.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Follow Kenton's stranger mission strand to its end and complete his final mission. Stranger strands unlock as the story progresses, so meet Kenton when his strand appears and keep returning for his missions. TechWiser (via EGamers) reports that stranger strands have windows tied to story progress, so finish Kenton's strand while the story is still running rather than leaving it for post-game. Source: the official description, as listed by Insider Gaming (hidden list); the story-window warning from EGamers.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Follow Billy's stranger mission strand to its end and complete his final mission. Stranger strands unlock as the story progresses, so meet Billy when his strand appears and keep returning for his missions. TechWiser (via EGamers) reports that stranger strands have windows tied to story progress, so finish Billy's strand while the story is still running. Source: the official description, as listed by Insider Gaming (hidden list); the story-window warning from EGamers.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full stranger mission strands across Leonida. Each strand is a chain of missions for one stranger — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and the other strangers — and a strand counts only when its final mission is done. This is the silver that ties the five stranger-final trophies together: finish any 8 strands. TechWiser (via EGamers) reports stranger strands have windows tied to story progress, so work on strands during the story, not only after it. Sources: the official description as listed by Insider Gaming and PushSquare; the story-window warning from EGamers.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Follow Randy's stranger mission strand to its end and complete his final mission. Stranger strands unlock as the story progresses, so meet Randy when his strand appears and keep returning for his missions. TechWiser (via EGamers) reports that stranger strands have windows tied to story progress, so finish Randy's strand while the story is still running. Source: the official description, as listed by Insider Gaming (hidden list); the story-window warning from EGamers.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Follow Tyrone's stranger mission strand to its end and complete his final mission. Stranger strands unlock as the story progresses, so meet Tyrone when his strand appears and keep returning for his missions. TechWiser (via EGamers) reports that stranger strands have windows tied to story progress, so finish Tyrone's strand while the story is still running. Source: the official description, as listed by Insider Gaming (hidden list); the story-window warning from EGamers.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every one of the 18 meditation spots across Leonida. This is the one trophy reported as possibly missable: GTABase and PowerPyx (via EGamers) flag it, and GTAScoop reports that one meditation spot is at Jason's house in Chapter 1, so meditate there while Chapter 1 is still running — do not rush past the early story without checking it. Work through the spots as you explore each region, and keep a note of which ones you have done. Sources: the official description as listed by Insider Gaming and PushSquare; the missable warning and the Chapter 1 house spot from EGamers and GTAScoop; the 18-spot count from KeenGamer.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Take on Bret's hunt and bring down the unique animal he asks for. Hunting is a side activity: follow Bret's strand until the hunt is offered, track the animal in the wild, and land the kill he wants. Source: the official description, as listed by Insider Gaming (hidden list) and PushSquare.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Collect the cards needed to complete 3 full collectible card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida as a collectible hunt: pick up every card you pass, check which sets are still incomplete, and finish any 3 sets — you do not need every card in the game, only 3 complete sets. Sources: the official description as listed by Insider Gaming and PushSquare.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK It feature at 100 different locations across Leonida. This is a pure exploration grind: as you travel, WAiNK It at every new spot you reach and let the count climb — it pairs naturally with exploring all 52 areas for The Goodtime State. Sources: the official description as listed by Insider Gaming and PushSquare.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges of any kind. Challenges are the small goals layered over the open world — driving, shooting, exploration and more — and they stack up as you play. Just keep playing the activities and side content and the count climbs; check the challenge list to find the easiest ones left. Sources: the official description as listed by Insider Gaming and PushSquare.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build up a 4-star wanted level, then lose the police and escape. Pick a busy spot, cause enough trouble to reach 4 stars together, then break line of sight, hide or outrun the search until the wanted level clears — escaping with your partner is what counts. Sources: the official description as listed by Insider Gaming and PushSquare.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row without the wanted level dropping between them. Plan a route with 3 shops close together, hit each one quickly, and keep moving — the streak breaks if the wanted level clears before the third robbery. Sources: the official description as listed by Insider Gaming and PushSquare.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles across Leonida. Vehicles count when you first find and drive them, so try every new car, bike, boat and aircraft you come across instead of sticking to one favourite. It pairs with exploring the map for The Goodtime State. Sources: the official description as listed by Insider Gaming and PushSquare.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: In one single use of Combat Focus, take down 5 enemies. Set it up where enemies group together — a gang hideout or a police shootout — then trigger Combat Focus and chain the takedowns before it ends. If you fall short, retry in a busier fight. Sources: the official description as listed by Insider Gaming and PushSquare.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: At VCIA, the Vice City International Airport, leave in a way the schedule never planned — steal a plane and take off without clearance. Head to the airport, get to an aircraft on the runway, and get airborne while the wanted level climbs. Source: the official description, as listed by Insider Gaming (hidden list) and PushSquare.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Do something memorable with Rhinos — the tanks. The description is a joke, not a checklist, so the method is the one the community reports: get into trouble with the military-grade Rhinos around, whether by stealing one or by surviving a confrontation with them. KeenGamer lists this among the trophies whose exact method is still being pinned down, so treat the Rhino encounter itself as the goal. Sources: the official description, as listed by Insider Gaming (hidden list); method notes from KeenGamer.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store cleanly, without any detection. Go in quietly — plan the approach, avoid cameras and staff sightlines, take the goods and leave before anyone raises the alarm. A loud robbery does not count, so patience beats speed here. Sources: the official description as listed by Insider Gaming and PushSquare.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. Each vault is a planned job: break in, crack the vault, grab the cash and get away clean before the police close in. You need 5 successful vault escapes in total, so repeat the job at different banks until the count is done. Sources: the official description as listed by Insider Gaming and PushSquare.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Find an armored truck on the road, rob it, and escape. Ambush the truck, break it open, take the cash and lose the wanted level that follows — the escape is part of the trophy, not just the robbery. Sources: the official description as listed by Insider Gaming and PushSquare.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. Drive, fly and sail into every named region until the map is filled in — the count is tracked by the game, so check which areas are still unvisited and head there. It pairs naturally with the WAiNK It and vehicle-discovery counts. Sources: the official description as listed by Insider Gaming and PushSquare; the 52-area count from KeenGamer.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs in Leonida. Each gang runs its own operations, so find one operation per gang, hit it, and move on to the next gang — the trophy needs all 9 gangs covered, not 9 hits on the same gang. Sources: the official description as listed by Insider Gaming and PushSquare; the 9-gang count from KeenGamer.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to Ocean Beach, order a cocktail at a beachside spot, and enjoy it with the ocean view. This is a quiet moment trophy: find the bar or vendor on Ocean Beach, buy the drink, and let the scene play. Source: the official description, as listed by Insider Gaming (hidden list) and PushSquare.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Drive a vehicle straight out of a showroom, smashing through the glass in classic GTA style. Pick a vehicle showroom, get in a car inside it, and floor it through the front — the smash exit is the point. Source: the official description, as listed by Insider Gaming (hidden list) and PushSquare.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Go bowling at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and follow through a full game. Find the alley, start a game of bowling, and play it through to the end. Sources: the official description, as listed by Insider Gaming (hidden list) and PushSquare.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Reach a partnership moment that draws a crowd — the description is deliberately vague, and the exact trigger is one the community is still pinning down. What is known is that it is tied to the partnership between the two leads and a public, crowd-drawing moment. KeenGamer lists this among the trophies whose precise method is still being confirmed, so check the community guides for the latest confirmed trigger before chasing it. Sources: the official description, as listed by Insider Gaming (hidden list); the unconfirmed-method note from KeenGamer.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Make choices — the game tracks them, with PlayStation counting up to 500. Choices appear all through the story and side content: dialogue picks, approach decisions and moral calls. There is nothing special to hunt here; keep choosing as you play and the count climbs to 500 over a full playthrough. Sources: the official description, as listed by Insider Gaming (hidden list); the 500-choice count is PlayStation's tracked count for this trophy.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Succeed on a second try — fail something, then succeed at the very next attempt. The natural way is a mission or activity you fail once and then clear on the retry; the trophy is about the comeback, so a failed first attempt followed by a success is the trigger. Sources: the official description, as listed by Insider Gaming (hidden list) and PushSquare.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Witness something strange — one of Leonida's weird, unscripted moments. This is the game's mystery trophy: it pops when you stumble into an odd event in the open world. KeenGamer reports its exact unlock method as still unconfirmed, so explore the stranger corners of the map and watch the community guides for the first confirmed trigger. Sources: the official description, as listed by Insider Gaming (hidden list); the unconfirmed-method note from KeenGamer.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Perform a melee drive-by: from a moving vehicle, strike someone with a melee weapon and knock them over. Slow the car beside a pedestrian, swing as you pass, and the knockdown is the trigger. KeenGamer notes the precise method is still being confirmed, so a slow drive-by with a melee weapon is the reported approach. Sources: the official description, as listed by Insider Gaming (hidden list); the method note from KeenGamer.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a total of $250,000 in Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and jobs; take them to your laundering contacts, convert them into clean cash, and repeat until the $250,000 total is reached. The count is cumulative, so small launders add up. Sources: the official description as listed by Insider Gaming and PushSquare.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 across all shops in Leonida. Buy weapons, clothes, cars and upgrades as you play — the total is cumulative across every shop, so normal spending across a playthrough gets you most of the way, and a late shopping spree finishes it. Sources: the official description as listed by Insider Gaming and PushSquare.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties in Leonida. Garages are bought as property: find each one for sale, pay its price, and keep buying until all 8 are yours. The money comes from story jobs, robberies and laundered Marked Bills, so buy garages as funds allow. Sources: the official description as listed by Insider Gaming and PushSquare; the 8-garage count from KeenGamer.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Open the app, register a vehicle you own or have found, and repeat for 10 different vehicles. It pairs with discovering 100 vehicles for Whip It Good — register the most interesting ones as you find them. Sources: the official description as listed by Insider Gaming and PushSquare.
trophies.name: On the Spot
